step1.title: Download from App Store
step1.description: Install the official AliPay app from the iOS App Store - ensure it's by Alipay (Hangzhou) Technology Co., Ltd.

step2.title: Sign Up with Mobile
step2.description: Tap 'Register' and use your international mobile number for account creation.

step3.title: Verify Identity
step3.description: Navigate to 'Account' → 'Settings' (the gear icon) → 'Account and Security' → 'Identity Verification' and upload your passport photo and a selfie.

step4.title: Await Verification
step4.description: Verification usually takes a few minutes, you can check if its completed by 'Account' → 'Settings' (the gear icon) → 'Account and Security' → 'Identity Information'

step5.title: Link Your Card
step5.description: Navigate to 'Account' → 'Settings' → 'Bank Cards' → '+' to add your international credit/debit card.

step6.title: Test your Payment
step6.description: To make sure your AliPay is working, you can test it by clicking the button below.

step1.title: Download from Google Play
step1.description: Install the official AliPay app from the Google Play Store - search for 'AliPay' and look for the official app by Alipay (Hangzhou) Technology Co., Ltd.

step2.title: Create Account with Phone
step2.description: Open AliPay and tap 'Sign Up'. Use your international phone number to create an account.

step3.title: Add International Card
step3.description: Go to 'Cards & Banks' → 'Add Card' and link your international Visa/Mastercard.

step4.title: Complete ID Verification
step4.description: Upload photos of your passport and take a selfie for identity verification.

step5.title: Set Up Payment PIN
step5.description: Create a 6-digit payment PIN and enable fingerprint/face unlock for faster payments.

step6.title: Enable Overseas Features
step6.description: In Settings → Payment Settings, enable 'Overseas Payment' for international card usage.
